subject: torrent duck
title: These Ducklings Jump Off a Cliff Into Whitewater on Their First Day

scenes.text: These ducklings' first swim is off a cliff, into whitewater.
Torrent ducks nest in crevices up to sixty feet above rushing Andean rivers.
The ducklings weigh about 35 grams when they plunge into the rapids.
And they can swim in that current immediately.
Adults cling to slippery rocks with a stiff tail and big claws, and dive under boulders for insect larvae.
They live up to 4,600 meters high. The calm pond is for other ducks.

description:
Torrent ducks live on fast mountain rivers in the Andes, from about 300 to 4,600 meters up.
They nest in cliff crevices above the water, and the 35-gram ducklings plunge straight into the rapids, already able to swim. Adults cling to rocks with a stiff tail and dive under boulders for food.
Would you take that first jump?
first_comment: Torrent ducks also have a sharp spur at the bend of each wing. What's the bravest baby animal you know?
